description: This file defines the NoteService interface in a Java Spring application, specifying methods for CRUD operations, partial updates, and paginated listing of notes with optional filters.
external_methods: Page<NoteResponse> list(String q, String tag, Pageable pageable)

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service interface for managing notes with CRUD operations, partial updates, and paginated listing.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from the provided request DTO.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its identifier.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Replaces a note's content using the provided request DTO.

methods.name: partialUpdate
methods.description: Partially updates a note. Only non-null fields in request are applied.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its identifier.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes with pagination and optional filters, supporting search by title/content and filtering by tags.

calls: Page<NoteResponse> list(String q, String tag, Pageable pageable)
